messages:
Miya (CSM): Heads up — prepping Rivet Health QBR for next Tue. Need a finalized cost ask list: token econ, spend forecasts, and budget alert thresholds. Who can own which piece?

Raj (CS Ops): I can pull the last 90d usage and spike cohorts. Will break down gen vs embeddings and per-route burn.

Ade (FinOps): I'll draft 3 forecast scenarios (baseline / growth / activation) and recommended guardrails (soft cap, hard cap, anomaly alerts). Need to confirm their current commit and renewal targets.

Jen (Solutions Eng): I noticed they flipped to embedding-heavy search last week — that will change token mix. I can produce per-prompt cost slices and sample evals to show quality tradeoffs.

qbot: :rotating_light: [COST ALERT] rivet-health account crossed 85% of monthly token threshold (auto-notify).

Sam (CS Ops): Got it. I'll capture enablement asks and block time on the calendar. Do we want a pre-QBR enablement session to walk their infra team through throttles/quotas?

Miya (CSM): Yes — add a pre-QBR 30m enablement run-through. Add to ask list: 1) 90d usage + cohort split, 2) 3 forecast scenarios + recommended commit options, 3) guardrail configs and alert thresholds, 4) embedding vs gen token cost comparison, 5) enablement plan + training slot, 6) renewal risk note if monthly spend >30% vs baseline.

Ade (FinOps): Quick Q — what's their current monthly commit? I have two playbooks: increase commit (discounted) or enable route-level throttling + burst buffer. Need commit number to recommend.

Raj (CS Ops): I have the current commit in the console but will export to CSV and attach. Also will run the usage query slice. SQL snippet I'll use:
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, route, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account_id = 98765 AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY day, route
ORDER BY day;
```

Jen (Solutions Eng): I'll output a small table mapping top 10 prompts to avg tokens and 95th pct. Will also flag any prompt templates we can optimize for fewer tokens.

Miya (CSM): Owners: Raj -> usage export & cohort splits, Ade -> forecasts & guardrails, Jen -> prompt/token slices + optimization notes, Sam -> enablement scheduling, Miya -> compile QBR deck + renewal risk section. ETA: EOD Fri for a draft.

Sam (CS Ops): Note for deck: call out last week's embedding rollout and the qbot alert as an action item, so ops/engineering can prevent mid-quarter surprises.

Ade (FinOps): I'll include a recommended alert threshold set: soft alert at 60% spend, ops nudge at 80%, auto-throttle at 95% — will draft wording for customer-facing options.

Raj (CS Ops): Uploading CSV + pivot to the shared doc now — link: https://redwood.internal/docs/cs/qbr/rivet-usage-90d (placeholder).

Miya (CSM): Perfect — :thumbsup: If everyone lands by EOD Fri I'll stitch the deck Sat morning and send to revops for review. Add any quick wins to the notes (e.g., replace a 10k token prompt with an embed + short prompt).

Jen (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll also attach a tiny demo script to show token savings:
```bash
# sample: reuse prefix cache for repeated assistants
redwoodctl runslice --account 98765 --route search --slice last_7_days --out tokens_by_prompt.csv
```

qbot: Reminder scheduled: QBR-prep checklist ping to channel on 3060004400.

Miya (CSM): Thanks team — keeping this tight so Rivet doesn't hit billing surprises. I'll post the draft deck link here when ready.
